title: API returns 500 instead of 401
context: A request to /profile without a token returns an internal error. The identity API works with demo-token.
expected: Requests without a token or with an unknown token return 401; valid identities return 200.
observed: A request to /profile without a token returns an internal error. The identity API works with demo-token.
acceptance_criteria: Requests without a token or with an unknown token return 401; valid identities return 200.
